content:
TEMPTATION ||| Twist the blade in my hand, letting him see the tension ||| "What if I tell the truth right now, Julian?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Pull my hand away, keeping the blade steady between us ||| "I won’t answer until you clarify what you mean."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, unguarded and raw ||| "I can't lie to you, even if I wanted to."  
REVERSAL ||| Step forward, closing the distance between us ||| "You think you control this? I decide my next move."  
SILENCE ||| Hold the blade still, breathing deeply ||| *A long, weighted breath.*
